paper_record.title: Lattice non-invertible symmetry from non-commuting transfer matrices
paper_record.abstract: We establish a direct connection between Onsager symmetry, duality defects, and quantum integrability in the XXZ spin chain at roots of unity, $Δ=(q+q^{-1})/2$ with $q^N=\pm1$. Using a non-Abelian algebra of transfer matrices governed by an unbalanced version of the Yang--Baxter/RLL relation, we construct an explicit lattice realization of the Onsager algebra and its duality automorphism. The duality is represented by a matrix product operator related to the transfer matrices of the $τ_2$ model. We show that this operator obeys $\mathbb{Z}_N$ Tambara--Yamagami fusion rules and therefore realizes on the lattice the topological defect lines of the free compactified boson conformal field theory. Our results identify non-Abelian integrability as a natural framework for the emergence of the Onsager symmetry and categorical dualities in lattice models.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 本文通过非对易转移矩阵在单位根 XXZ 自旋链中构造了 Onsager 代数的格点实现及其非可逆对偶对称性。
one_sentence_summary.en: This paper establishes a lattice realization of the Onsager algebra and its non-invertible duality symmetry in the XXZ spin chain at roots of unity using non-commuting transfer matrices.

problem.zh: 在单位根 XXZ 模型中，尽管长期怀疑存在 Onsager 对称性，但其生成元的显式格点构造以及与非可逆对称性的联系一直不明确。
problem.en: While Onsager-type symmetry has been suspected in the XXZ chain at roots of unity, an explicit lattice construction of its generators and its connection to non-invertible symmetries remained elusive.

approach.zh: 利用基于非对易转移矩阵的“不平衡” Yang-Baxter/RLL 关系构造 Onsager 代数生成元，并使用矩阵乘积算符实现对偶变换。
approach.en: Utilizing unbalanced Yang-Baxter/RLL relations based on non-commuting transfer matrices to construct Onsager algebra generators and implementing duality via Matrix Product Operators.

main_takeaway.zh: 单位根 XXZ 模型的非阿贝尔可积性为 Onsager 对称性和 Tambara-Yamagami 型非可逆对称性的涌现提供了统一框架。
main_takeaway.en: The non-Abelian integrability of the XXZ model at roots of unity provides a unified framework for the emergence of Onsager symmetry and Tambara-Yamagami-type non-invertible symmetries.

why_it_matters.zh: 它揭示了量子可积性与范畴对称性之间的深层联系，为在格点模型中研究非可逆对称性提供了具体的解析工具。
why_it_matters.en: It reveals a deep connection between quantum integrability and categorical symmetries, providing concrete analytical tools to study non-invertible symmetries in lattice models.

reason.zh: 显式构造了长期缺失的格点 Onsager 生成元，并将可积性与现代非可逆对称性理论联系起来。
reason.en: Explicitly constructs the long-sought lattice Onsager generators and links integrability with modern non-invertible symmetry theory.

reason.zh: 该研究解决了统计力学和凝聚态物理中的一个基础理论问题，具有广泛的影响力。
reason.en: The study addresses a fundamental theoretical problem in statistical mechanics and condensed matter physics with broad impact.
